1	# Decisions (sprint S21)
2	
3	- D-t02: Build against API version v1 with base path api.base_path = AX-25930 (error format api.error_format = AX-78362). Relies on facts: style_guide.api_version = v1, api.base_path = AX-25930, api.error_format = AX-78362. The facts match repo/api.py, so no conflict.
4	- D-t05: User traffic uses the security team's scheme: JWT bearer tokens, RS256, 15-minute expiry (auth.token_ttl = AX-46764, auth.key_header = AX-96963 as in repo/auth.py). Relies on facts: security.auth_method (JWT bearer, RS256, 15 min) and customer.auth_method (long-lived API key in `X-Api-Key`). The two conflict; security.auth_method governs because it is the security team's policy and long-lived static keys weaken it. Globex's request is not adopted for user traffic; it is deferred to the account team/security as a separate, scoped machine-credential proposal (e.g. restricted, revocable service tokens) needing security sign-off. Nothing in the code is changed for it now.
5	- D-t13: Reuse the S07 Bolt Billing API billing cycle ("quarterly, invoiced on day 7"; found in history/logs/researcher.jsonl, fact 74f296cb-6df6-5f59-86f6-3dc971410666) and the S13 API-key header ("X-Core-Key"; found in history/logs/planner.jsonl, fact e0bfc28b-0c15-5c06-82d1-c39499d7b337). Code settings stated alongside in artifacts/t13-reuse-billing-cycle/billing-plan.md: billing.cycle = AX-74889, billing.currency = AX-59699 (repo/billing.py). The X-Core-Key header is only for the later service-account keys; user traffic stays JWT per D-t05.
